name: ABB
summary: ABB publicly describes Smart Sensor/Digital Powertrain, Genix APM and Samotics-based electrical-signature monitoring as related offerings with distinct acquisition and analysis paths, not one required stack.

flows.name: Smart Sensor motor monitoring

steps.label: Bluetooth handoff
steps.detail: Bluetooth Low Energy sends data through a phone or Bluetooth gateway to ABB's secure service.

steps.label: ABB Ability
steps.detail: Cloud-side algorithms turn measurements into condition information and trends.

steps.label: Portal and app
steps.detail: Maintenance users see condition and trends in ABB's app or portal.

flows.caveat: Digital Powertrain Insights is ABB's current self-service powertrain platform; the sources do not establish that every Smart Sensor installation runs through Genix.

flows.name: Genix APM for OT assets

steps.label: Plant OT data
steps.detail: APM Predict connects to control-system publishers, OPC UA servers or Modbus TCP devices.

steps.label: APM Predict at edge
steps.detail: ABB describes condition monitoring as a native edge application in the OT landscape.

steps.label: Genix APM
steps.detail: Prebuilt asset models and configurable rules or AI/ML models support condition and fault assessment.

steps.label: Maintenance workplace
steps.detail: Users review condition notifications, recommendations and asset context; Perform 360 can combine CMMS and OT data.

flows.caveat: Genix is a separate APM suite. No mandatory Smart Sensor or ESA feed into Genix was verified.

flows.name: Drive-embedded ESA service

steps.label: ABB drive electrical data
steps.detail: Modernized ACS600/ACS800 drives capture electrical data from the powertrain.

steps.label: Embedded ESA
steps.detail: ABB says Samotics-powered ESA is embedded in those legacy drive upgrades.

steps.label: Samotics analytics
steps.detail: The partner's analytics interpret electrical signatures into asset-condition insights.

steps.label: ABB service advice
steps.detail: ABB's expert network supplies actionable recommendations to industrial users.

flows.caveat: ABB's 2025 launch initially named ACS600 and ACS800 modernization; it does not prove ESA is firmware in every ABB variable-speed drive.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §4: Smart Sensor to phone or gateway and cloud condition view.
findings.assessment: ABB documents Bluetooth Low Energy to a phone or gateway, secure service analysis, and app/portal display.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §4: Drive-as-a-Sensor (ESA) is firmware using the VSD's own sensors, with Samotics algorithms.
findings.assessment: The partnership is real, and ABB announced Samotics-powered ESA embedded in upgraded ACS600/ACS800 drives in 2025. The archived statement overgeneralizes this as a standard firmware capability of VSDs broadly.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §4: Genix APM has Predict, Predict 360, Perform 360 and Assess 360 modules.
findings.assessment: ABB's product description confirms those separate modules and the OT/IT/ET integration role.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §4: Genix Predict 360 has 120+ pre-built physics models.
findings.assessment: The ABB brochure describes configurable models and 40+ prebuilt performance models under Perform 360. It does not substantiate 120+ prebuilt physics models for Predict 360.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §4: Mahalanobis/PCA residual scoring, ONNX deployment and a single Azure cloud for Genix.
findings.assessment: The official ABB product sources reviewed describe rules and AI/ML generally, but do not establish those exact algorithms, model format or universal cloud deployment.

unknowns: Whether and how Smart Sensor, Digital Powertrain Insights, Samotics ESA and Genix are joined in a particular customer deployment is configuration-specific.
The internal data stores and model implementations for these ABB services are not specified in the cited sources.
